# Es Venture

> Whatever it is - if it's digital, I've got it. A digital partner for founders and teams who need someone to think it, build it, and ship it.

Es Venture is the personal practice of Esther - a digital partner who helps founders and teams build new things, fix stuck projects, and ship work that actually matters. The site operates as a one-page "User Manual": visitors scroll through a structured narrative that explains when to reach out, what kinds of work Esther takes on, and how to start a project.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of services, client logos, project planner, and contact.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): Data handling and privacy terms.
- [Style Guide](/styleguide): Brand colors, typography, and component reference.
